name: drip-seo-executor
description: Use ChatGPT research and reasoning to resolve exact product identity/SKU, then execute Drip Sneakers SEO-PDP V4.4 through the existing local MrShopPlus Agent.

interface.shortDescription: Research SKU/entity in ChatGPT, then execute V4.4 in MrShopPlus.
interface.longDescription: Connects ChatGPT to the existing local Drip Sneakers automation. ChatGPT resolves exact entity and SKU evidence; the plugin prepares an immutable V4.4 dry-run plan, executes it through the local Agent/MrShopPlus API, and verifies the storefront result.
defaultPrompt: Find the requested products, resolve Exact Entity and SKU with evidence, and execute SEO-PDP V4.4.
Audit these Drip Sneakers PDPs, HOLD any unresolved SKU/entity, then fix and verify the rest.
Optimize this product category page without applying PDP-only SKU rules.
